title: Domestic Hygiene
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Children help clean the classroom as a practical. Strong chemicals are never used by children; plain soap and water do the work.

skills.key_step: The child describes the methods of cleaning a home (sweeping, dusting, mopping, scrubbing, wiping, polishing, disposing of rubbish) and which surface or dirt each suits.
steps: Look at the dirt: dust, mud, grease, rubbish.

board.do: Draw a shelf with dust and a floor with mud.

misconceptions.ask: Which method removes dry dirt from a floor?
misconceptions.repair: Try to sweep a muddy floor and mop a dusty one.
Wipe a table with a cloth and look at the dust on it.

listen_for: Anywhere outside, the wind will take it
misconceptions.ask: Where should rubbish from the house go?
misconceptions.repair: Walk round the school and look at where rubbish piles up and what it attracts.

misconceptions.ask: Which method suits a dirty cemented veranda?
misconceptions.repair: Try a dry cloth on a muddy floor tile, then a brush and soapy water.

checks.question: Which method removes dust from a shelf?
Where should rubbish go?
checks.answer: in a dustbin or rubbish pit

skills.key_step: The child puts cleaning jobs in order (open windows, remove rubbish, dust from top to bottom, sweep, then mop or scrub, put things back) and picks the right tool, washing the least dirty items first.

floor.question: Which method uses water and a mop?

representations: picture cards of the jobs to put in order
a real broom, duster and mop
a drawing of a room top to bottom

board.do: Write the cards: sweep, dust, mop.

misconceptions.ask: Which job comes first when cleaning a room?
misconceptions.repair: Dust a shelf over a swept floor and look at the floor again.

misconceptions.ask: What comes first, sweeping or mopping?
misconceptions.repair: Mop a dusty floor and see the mud it makes.
Wash a cup after a greasy pot in the same water and feel it.

misconceptions.ask: What should you do before sweeping a room?
misconceptions.repair: Sweep a dusty corner with windows closed and open; watch where the dust goes.

checks.question: Why do we dust before sweeping?
checks.answer: dust falls to the floor and is swept up

checks.question: Which dishes are washed first?
checks.answer: the least dirty, like glasses and cups
